claims.statement: An advertisement for a saloon on Market Street describes its owner as the 'champion pugilist' of the world and offers a free concert every evening with the best singers only.
claims.excerpt:
champion pugilist
world street. Free concert every
evening, Best of singers only engaged here,

notes: Tom Allen is not named in the OCR; the name and address are garbled. Attribution to Allen rests on the ad wording and the article title. The hint's street number 619 is not legible in this text.
